ideas.statement: Put a benefit-led line next to the QR code, e.g. "Scan for the story behind this bar".

sources.publisher: GS1 UK, five ways to increase QR adoption
sources.note: Give people a reason to scan; specific prompts beat "Learn more".
Keep call-to-action text outside the code's quiet zone.

ideas.statement: Send each code to its own product page, not the home page.

sources.publisher: Retail Brew, on a 2026 report of ~8,500 pack codes
sources.note: Purpose-built product pages averaged over 7× the scans of plain website redirects.

ideas.statement: Make "92%" the largest text on the front of the wrapper.
basis: How competitors name their bars (Market context)

sources.note: The competitor leads its product name with the cocoa %.

ideas.statement: Show price per 100 g on shelf talkers: the 80 g bar sits next to 100 g bars.

sources.note: Comparable bar sold at 80 g with price per kg shown.
